# FQHESphereMPSCorrelation

Module: **FQHE** · directory: `FQHE/src/FQHEOnSphere` · binary: `FQHE/src/Programs/FQHEOnSphere/FQHESphereMPSCorrelation`

```text
FQHESphereMPSCorrelation, version 0.01

Usage: FQHESphereMPSCorrelation [options] 

Options:

system options:
    --p-truncation : truncation level (default value = 1)
    --laughlin-index : index of the Laughlin state to generate (default value = 3)
    --k-2 : consider the (k=2,r) series of clustered states
    --optimized-k2 : used an optimized version of the (k=2,r) series of clustered states
    --n1-superconformal : consider the N=1 superconformal states (requires a cft description)
    --rr-3 : consider the k= 3 Read-Rezayi state
    --ph-pfaffian : PH-Pfaffian state
    --r-index : r index of the (k,r) clustered state (default value = 2)
    --boson : use bosonic statistics
    --boson-truncation : maximum occupation for a given orbital (default value = 1)
    --cft : use a file that described the CFT to be used
    --quasihole-sector : look at the quasihole sector for the (k=2,r) series of clustered states and the RR state
    --quasiholesector-left : consider the quasihole sector for the left B matrix
    --quasiholesector-right : consider the quasihole sector for the right B matrix
    --with-quasiholes : state has to be built with quasihole whose location is given in a text file
    --symmetrize : symmetrize two copies of the same state
    --anti-symmetrize : anti-symmetrize two copies of the same state
    --unalign-sector : choose the unaligned sector when symmetrizing / anti-symmetrizing
    --twisted-symmetrize : symmetrize or anti-symmetrize two copies of the same state, using a twist
    --twisted-shift : set which orbital should be set to zero when (anti-)symmetrizing with a twist (default value = 1)
    --trim-qsector :  trim the charge indices, assuming an iMPS
    --fixed-qsector : use a group of B matrices to fix the charge sector
    --unnormalized-b : use the unnormalized B matrix
    --truncate : use a set of matrices to write MPS in canonical form and project onto the highest weight Schmidt states
    --qsector-value : charge sector to consider when using the --fixed-qsector option (default value = 0)
    --use-nonrational : use double numbers instead of rational numbers for CFT calcaultions
    --reference-file : file that describes the root configuration
    --use-padding : root partitions use the extra zero padding
    --hopping-cutoff : cutoff on the hopping processes (=|m1-m3|) (default value = -1)
    --origin-x : x coordinate of the origin (for pair correlation) (default value = 0)
    --origin-y : y coordinate of the origin (for pair correlation) (default value = 0)
    --initial-x : starting point x coordinate (for pair correlation) (default value = 0)
    --initial-y : starting point y coordinate (for pair correlation) (default value = 0)
    --final-x : x coordinate of the final point (for pair correlation) (default value = 10)
    --final-y : y coordinate of the final point (for pair correlation) (default value = 0)
    -n, --nbr-points : number of point to evaluate (default value = 1000)
    -r, --radians : set units to radians instead of magnetic lengths
    -c, --chord : use chord distance instead of distance on the sphere
    --infinite-cylinder : evaluate density on the infinite cylinder
    --density : plot density insted of density-density correlation
    --coefficients-only : only compute the one or two body coefficients that are requested to evaluate the density-density correlation
    --state : provide an external state for comparison purposes

precalculation options:
    --import-bmatrices : import the B matrices from a given binary file instead of computing them
    --export-bmatrices : export the B matrices in a binary file
    --export-bmatrixname : use a custom output file name to export the B matrices instead of the default one
    --only-export : only export the B matrices in a binary file and exit from the program
    --matrices-cft : optional directory where the geomerty independent CFT matrices are stored
    --memory : amount of memory that can used for precalculations (in Mb) (default value = 500)

output options:
    -c, --normalize-cylinder : express the MPS in the normalized cylinder basis
    -r, --aspect-ratio : aspect ratio of the cylinder (default value = 1)
    --cylinder-perimeter : if non zero, fix the cylinder perimeter (in magnetic length unit) instead of the aspect ratio (default value = 0)
    --show-bmatrices : show the B matrices
    --show-fullphysical : show the physical indices of the B matrices
    --show-fulllabel : when displaying an auxiliary space index, show its full description (i.e. including its quantum numbers)
    --show-auxiliaryspace : show the auxiliary space
    -o, --output-file : output file name

parallelization options:
    -S, --SMP : enable SMP mode
    --processors : number of processors to use in SMP mode (default value = 2)
    --smp-profil : enable SMP profiling, the name of the log file  has to be passed as argument

misc options:
    -h, --help : display this help

global options:
    --append-cmdline : append command line to file
```
